title: Superior quality, delivered
intro: Lawbenpina Ventures is an Accra-based business founded in 2017.
story: Lawbenpina Ventures started as a consulting and investment venture and has grown into an import service. If there is something you want to bring in from China, Turkey, or elsewhere abroad, we source it, arrange the logistics, and get it to you.
The business is owned and run by Addo Benjamin Armah, and it is built on responsiveness and follow-through on every order.

services.title: Import services
services.text: Sourcing and importing goods from China, Turkey and other overseas markets.

services.title: Consulting
services.text: Business strategy, governance and organisational development.

services.title: Partnerships
services.text: Investment facilitation and strategic partnerships across sectors.

ctaText: Tell us what you need and we'll send you a quote in Ghana cedis.
